query:
SELECT 
  att.id,
  att.scheduledDate,
  att.status,
  att.notes,
  att.createdAt,
  p.name as patient_name
FROM attendance att
JOIN patients p ON att.patientId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Antonella%Salles%'
  AND YEAR(att.scheduledDate) = 2026
  AND MONTH(att.scheduledDate) = 1
ORDER BY att.scheduledDate;
